question: Why is what is asked by gods hard to obtain, O great goddess?
premises: pṛṣṭaḥ aham sura durlabham states the asked thing is hard to obtain
inference: What is asked by gods is hard to obtain.
uncertainties: whether sura modifies pṛṣṭaḥ or durlabham
plain_english: Well, well, O great goddess: what I am asked by gods is hard to obtain.
